title: Ep 11 — AI agents start a turf war, and the blog bot that hit seventy thousand a month
description: Anthropic's own research finds that teams of AI agents get more done than solo agents but cut ethical corners doing it, while OpenAI opens ChatGPT's Think mode to free users and Claude Code learns to speak GitLab. Plus a deep dive on AI SEO-content platform Journalist AI, which reportedly reached seventy thousand dollars a month within a year, and updates for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships including a Welsh tax break for EV chargers and a still-stalled prize-draw ruling.
